scientific_boundary: This snapshot-and-ledger commit closes the independent review round on the r_R candidate-definition draft. RT103-C1 (the self-contained-definition control for H-CREP-001's r_R, open since 2026-07-22) is judged PARTIALLY discharged: the definitions of g_I, z_R, source occurrence maps, multiplicities, and the forward direction of the support biconditional are independently, adversarially re-verified as genuine mathematical content. The choice between the one-pair/Theta(B^2) and two-pairs/Theta(B^4) deck-structure readings remains unadjudicated -- the strongest attempt yet to justify a choice left the rejected reading equally textually coherent under a proves-too-much control. The converse direction of the support biconditional remains a conditional proof sketch. A new, more decisive obstruction (OBJ-5) is recorded: neither candidate reading supplies a construction of r_R meeting H-CREP-001's own declared exponent caps when materialized directly. DEC-20260830-d7b846 records this composed verdict and recommends against further reading-reconstruction attempts on the same exhausted source text, redirecting future effort toward OBJ-5 (a compact/implicit representation of z_R within cap) as the more consequential and more tractable open question. KN-OPEN-de67f0 is superseded by KN-OPEN-701adf accordingly. H-CREP-001's status (approved) and EXP-CREP-001's specification (frozen) are unchanged. No B71, experiment, attack, speedup, novelty, closure, support, or breakthrough is claimed.
